name: Numa donation-manipulable vault price used as lending oracle
summary: NumaVault prices NUMA from its raw rETH balanceOf divided by circulating supply, and NumaPriceOracleNew feeds that spot price to the Numa lending comptroller for both collateral and debt. Within one flash-loaned transaction the attacker built a looped NUMA short against rETH collateral, sold the borrowed NUMA into the vault, donated 150 rETH to the vault to lift the oracle NUMA debt price from 116.94e12 to 161.23e12 wei, then liquidated its own position 26 times to recover its collateral and borrowed rETH against its remaining cNUMA, draining the vault.

loss.notes: NumaVault rETH depletion across the exploit transaction and the attacker's same-session vault sale (source-2), net of attacker-supplied rETH that stayed in the vault (150 rETH donation, 10 rETH buy) and excluding 3.890749723489182171 rETH of protocol fees paid to Numa's own fee/reward Safe. Recipients: attacker 292.969043721660915071 rETH (matches the project's reported 292.96 rETH), Aave rETH flash-loan premium 1.116841928270578525 rETH. cNUMA lenders' 3,626,482.92 NUMA (bad debt) were burned into the vault for this rETH and are not counted again. Later team/partner recapitalisation does not reduce gross loss.

ageReset.description: Stateless immutable NumaPriceOracleNew returns vault.numaToLst / lstToNuma spot prices as the comptroller's collateral and borrow prices; it is the latest-deployed defect-bearing artifact. Launch wiring (_setPriceOracle 39 blocks later, market listing, collateral factors, borrow unpause) sets ordinary non-erroneous values and does not reset age.
Immutable NumaVault runtime reads lstToken.balanceOf(this) in getVaultBalance, so an unaccounted rETH transfer reprices NUMA; it also hosts liquidateNumaBorrower used for the self-liquidations.

limitations: Price-source half of one failure: deployed at block 310852851, 6837 blocks (1710 s) before the consuming NumaPriceOracleNew (target-1), which carries the knot. VaultManager 0x2b8ceb24761d585bd5bc03172253d8f570e76c47 (aggregates vault.getEthBalance into the price, deployed earlier at block 310852772) is not separately targeted.

sources.note: Verified sources via Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=42161 (v0.8.20+commit.a1b79de6, optimizer 100 runs). SHA-256 of returned SourceCode: NumaVault 76ceb9b14d75d1742eeb70f9f81629dde1e5ae0bd76f25df7b1a0011a5b7d0f4; NumaPriceOracleNew 9c7520c80f277e1b954d7725d4bf623f7897e1ba1d1af3c2960d660a79a991b6; VaultManager 1d757ed3b837c7d2bb376a3cd01a86fec2eb2d92034bc22d9ce1076339b76771. Inspect NumaVault.getVaultBalance/getVaultBalanceNoDebt (lstToken.balanceOf(address(this)) when !isLiquidityLocked), getEthBalance, numaToLst/lstToNuma, liquidateNumaBorrower; VaultManager.getTotalBalanceEth/numaToToken/tokenToNuma (price = (EthBalance - synthValue)/circulatingNuma); NumaPriceOracleNew.getUnderlyingPriceAsCollateral/AsBorrowed (return vault.numaToLst(1e18) and 1e36/vault.lstToNuma(1e18)). Neither artifact is a proxy and neither has an upgrade or selfdestruct path.

Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 327780446, tx index 1, from 0xf0314c7c...a688 to attacker contract 0xc16aa4f0...cd9c): Balancer flashLoan 1526.436 rETH and Aave flashLoanSimple 2233.684 rETH, Uniswap V3 pool 0x804ac892... flash 323121.41 NUMA and WeightedIndex 0x03d28399... flash 308301.40 NUMA; cReth 0xcca00ada... mint 3760.120 rETH; six cNUMA 0x3051b18b... borrows of 3626482.922 NUMA, five re-minted into cNUMA by helper 0x8594a25d...; NumaVault.sell(3626482.922 NUMA) -> 312.339 rETH; cReth redeemUnderlying 1027.543+51.377+2.569 rETH; vault buy(10 rETH); direct rETH transfer of 150 to the vault (receipt log 77); 26 helper calls NumaVault.liquidateNumaBorrower(attacker,631422.81 NUMA x25 / 502295.85 NUMA x1,false,false), each followed by cNUMA redeemUnderlying; helper cReth borrow 131.874 rETH. STATICCALL outputs of NumaPriceOracleNew.getUnderlyingPriceAsBorrowed(cNUMA) (selector 0x973a819a) in trace order: 148850422003939 before the sale, 116943924501586 after it, 161231098992573 immediately after the 150 rETH donation, when the first cNUMA LiquidateBorrow is admitted. eth_call at block 327780445: getUnderlyingPriceAsBorrowed(cNUMA)=148850422003939, vault.numaToLst(1e18)=86127329805844 (the post-mortem's pre-incident 0.00008612 rETH), comptroller 0x057b326b....oracle()=0xa199d97f..., borrowCaps(cNUMA)=0; isLiquidityLocked() reverts (not exposed) and the trace shows the donation moving the price, so the raw-balance branch was live. Classified as a code defect: the protocol's own oracle is repriced atomically by an unaccounted transfer into the vault; not manipulation of an external oracle. The uncapped NUMA borrow (borrowCaps 0, never set) is a risk parameter that enlarged exposure and does not reset age. Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs on cNUMA from its deployment block 310859852 to 327780445 finds zero Borrow(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) (0x13ed6866...) and zero LiquidateBorrow (0x298637f6...) events; source-1 emits 6 and 26. The attacker EOA's Etherscan txlist has no earlier interaction with Numa contracts; its helper and attack contracts were created at blocks 327778340 and 327778714. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at deployment block-1 for both targets; keccak256(runtime) at deployment block, 327780445 and latest: oracle 0x681093b3...12a2 (block 310859688), vault 0xbf1f1013...3a64 (block 310852851). Source-3/source-4 receipts: top-level creations by 0x47786ac88f8cdb8d3a5fe956e51f95b4ae9636fa, tx indices 64 and 1. Config review: Etherscan txlist of that deployer/admin for blocks 310800000..327800000 (91 txs) shows launch wiring on 2025-02-28 (_setPriceOracle 0x208ebc9d... block 310859727, setCTokens 0x16a99c8f... block 310860080, _supportMarket, close factor 1e18, liquidation incentive 1.02e18, collateral factors 0.95e18 at blocks 310898453/310898563, mint unpause, borrow unpause for cNUMA 0xd5470674... block 310899140 and cReth 0x88236624... block 310899220), then setMaxBorrow (blocks 311139436, 311224840; caps vault rETH lent to cReth: exposure only) and cReth _setInterestRateModel (block 311224408), then ownership transfers at blocks 311515559..311515777 and nothing after. Owner Safe 0xfc4b72fd...b881 ExecutionSuccess logs after the transfer (6 txs, blocks 313304085..314662445, plus one 0.2 ETH send at 314661885) are all acceptOwnership (0x79ba5097) calls. No launch value is erroneous; deployment supplies the age, as for initial wiring elsewhere in the dataset. Knot: oracle deployment 1740765116 to exploit 1745010628.
